Browsing this website

This personal website presents my businesses, studies and projects. It has no account registration, newsletter, advertising tracker or analytics integration. Its project filters and notes work in your browser and are not sent to me.

Contact and external websites

The contact selector changes which website a link opens. It does not collect or send a message. If you choose a business website or GitHub, that service has its own privacy information and any enquiry is handled there.

Device features

The copy-link button writes the public website address to your clipboard only when you press it. This site does not use local storage or set its own optional cookies.

Hosting and access

OpenAI Sites and Cloudflare provide hosting and technical security. They may process connection information and operational logs needed to serve and protect the site. While access is private, ChatGPT sign-in is managed by the hosting provider.

Questions

Use the GitHub profile linked from this website to identify the website owner and their public project presence. Business-specific privacy enquiries should use the contact route on the relevant business website.
